simple.summary: אֲנָחֲרָת (ʼĂnâchărâth) means Anacharath , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Josh 19 19.

definitions.full: H588. Anacharath אֲנָָֽחֲרָ֫ת proper name, of a location a city in Naphtali Josh 19:19 . Kn (compare Di) compare en-Na`ûra , on east side of Jebel Dahi, little Hermon; compare Rob BR iii. 339 .
definitions.rootNote: probably from the same root as 5170 ; a gorge or narrow pass;
